critical_landmarks.name: Ring Road Underpass #43
critical_landmarks.failure_mechanism: Surface runoff pooling in depression basin; reverse sewer surcharge from saturated Barapullah outfall.

critical_landmarks.name: ITO Bridge & Sluice Regulator
critical_landmarks.failure_mechanism: Yamuna crest breach; silted sluice gates jammed, causing reverse backflow into Vikas Marg.

critical_landmarks.name: Minto Bridge Underpass
critical_landmarks.failure_mechanism: Gravity drainage capacity exhausted; underpass water level exceeds 1.8 meters, stalling bus transit.

critical_landmarks.name: Maharani Bagh 400kV Substation
critical_landmarks.failure_mechanism: Substation transformer basements inundated; automatic thermal and earth-fault disconnects tripped.

critical_landmarks.name: AIIMS Apex Trauma Center Corridor
critical_landmarks.failure_mechanism: Access arterial routes blocked by floodwaters; emergency trauma ambulance arrivals delayed by 45 minutes.

critical_landmarks.name: IGI Airport Terminal-3 Expressway Corridor
critical_landmarks.failure_mechanism: Feeder ramp waterlogging; regional passenger transfers stranded on airport expressway.

cascade_timeline.desc: Rainfall exceeds 90 mm/hr; localized runoff overwhelms surface drainage.
Trunk sewer outfalls submerged; reverse backflow inundates lowlands.
Ring Road underpasses flooded; traffic speeds plunge 82%.
Trauma center ambulance arrivals delayed; regional emergency rooms hit 88% capacity.
Basement transformer flooding triggers power trips across affected zones.

directives.details: Mobilize 4 diesel pumps (500 HP each) to eject water into Barapullah elevated drain.
Divert all commercial and non-emergency traffic via Outer Ring Road.
Stage 8 advanced life support ambulances on elevated carriageways for rapid trauma dispatch.
Engage perimeter flood gates; prepare automatic power load redistribution.

cascade_timeline.desc: 350,000 cusecs discharged upstream; surge wave travels down Yamuna channel.
Water level breaches 208m; floodplain settlements and agricultural tracts submerged.
Old Yamuna Bridge and Geeta Colony road closed to traffic.
Wazirabad and Chandrawal water treatment plants submerged; municipal supply cut.

directives.location: Kashmere Gate to Mayur Vihar Floodplains
directives.details: Relocate 25,000 residents to elevated municipal school relief camps.
Deploy sandbag revetments and emergency sheet piling.
Stage 400 municipal potable water tankers to compensate for WTP shutdowns.

cascade_timeline.desc: Damaged potable pipes infiltrate sewage; bacterial contamination index surges.
Emergency hotline receives 4x call surge reporting acute fever and dehydration.
Trauma and infectious disease wards exceed 95% capacity; IV fluids stock critical.
Ambulance response times delayed; patient transfers diverted to neighboring states.

directives.action: Distribute Emergency Water Purification & ORS Kits
directives.details: Distribute 100,000 chlorine tablets and oral rehydration salts via health workers.

directives.location: Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium & Community Halls
directives.details: Erect 500-bed field triage clinic with dedicated oxygen and rehydration bays.
Elevate residual chlorine to 0.5 ppm at distribution points.

cascade_timeline.desc: Dry bulb temperature hits 46.5°C; urban heat island intensifies in concrete dense zones.
Peak electricity load hits 8,650 MW; distribution transformers run at thermal limits.
400kV transformers trigger automatic thermal cutoffs; rolling load shedding initiated.
Power cuts halt municipal booster pumps; drinking water delivery drops 60%.

directives.action: Activate Public Cooling Shelters & Water Stations
directives.details: Open air-conditioned shelters with medical hydration staff.
Deploy fire service water mist sprays to cool transformer radiator fins.

directives.action: Emergency Generator Fuel Reserves for Hospitals
directives.details: Top up diesel generator reserves to 72-hour operating capacity.

cascade_timeline.desc: All urban transit corridors, drainage gates, power lines, and emergency rooms operate within safe design margins.

directives.details: Maintain scheduled preventive maintenance of drainage intake grills.
